units.body_md: Pons' daily fees slid about 78% from a $4.89 million peak on August 31 to roughly $1.07 million, and the timeline shows most of that damage landed before Robinhood's gas subsidy ended on September 29. Of the $123.97 million users paid in fees over 30 days, DefiLlama counts only $20.7 million as protocol revenue, with $16.96 million flowing to PONS holders, [per Memeburn's read of the data](https://memeburn.com/pons-made-124m-in-fees-in-30-days/).

units.why_did_i_see_this: You keep a close read on what the Robinhood Chain economy actually earns after the subsidy era, and this one separates the memecoin fee wave from the trading that survived it.
